svg.desc: A sparse autoencoder on the residual stream at block 14: the encoder maps x to 32,768 feature activations z and keeps the k largest; the decoder W_dec writes their sum of directions back as x-hat, which is spliced into the stream, with the error x minus x-hat kept or dropped as a dashed side branch. Annotations: reconstruct (splice x-hat), ablate (clamp feature z_j to 0), steer (add alpha times the decoder column w_j).
